sermon.title: Hope and Change
sermon.series: Bible Morality Banned by Wimps and Born by Warriors
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: From Philippians 3:13–14 the speaker calls hearers to forget what is behind and press to God’s top goal—loving God and neighbor (Matthew 22) and the church—by adding virtue, knowledge, self-control, patience, godliness, brotherly love, and love (2 Peter 1). Love leads to knowing God (John 17:3). He urges correcting criminal sinners, says humanists reject God’s rule, judges movements by fruit (Matthew 7) and sowing (Galatians 6:7), cites abortion, STD, work, and family statistics against humanist policy, and calls Christians out of the closet as warriors who admit wrong, repent, and unite to make America righteous again.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Long auto-caption transcript (~40 min); punctuation light via scripted fixes—some run-ons remain. Caption fixes: Philippians/Matthew/Galatians colon refs; “criminal sinner” for “criminal center.” HIGHLY SENSITIVE: abortion (“50 million babies”), graphic policy critique, homosexuality/same-sex marriage, illegal immigration/sex trafficking, evolution-in-schools, “come out of the closet” rhetoric, humanist/atheist blame, unverified statistics (STD >50%, HIV 2M+, AIDS deaths 650k+, 40% not working, 44% single-parent, etc.). Flag all stats for Michael. Speaker not named—confirm Kincer. Series Part 15 between You Are to Blame (14) and Clarity (16).

faqs.question: What does “forget those things which are behind” mean for personal failure?
faqs.answer: He says there’s a place to get over old mistakes—God forgave you, forgive yourself, and go forward instead of condemning yourself for flaws until you correct them.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Brethren, I do not count myself to have apprehended; but one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forward to those things which are ahead, I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.

faqs.question: What commandments does he call the high invitation of God?
faqs.answer: Love God with all your heart, soul, and mind, and love your neighbor as yourself—plus Jesus’ new command to love one another in the true church.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like it: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

faqs.question: What is self-control if you are waiting for a Holy Ghost meeting?
faqs.answer: Self-control is you controlling yourself—quit waiting for a phone call from God or a meeting to make you refrain from wrong; add it to your faith.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness,

faqs.question: When does he say you are not ready for marriage?
faqs.answer: If you can’t afford to support a woman and baby and want a baby, you’re not ready—get education, job skill, and get your act together.

faqs.question: How does John 17:3 define eternal life here?
faqs.answer: That they may know the only true God and Jesus Christ—knowing God/love, not grace-and-faith-plus-nothing without growth.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

faqs.question: How do you love a sinner who is a criminal?
faqs.answer: By correcting them—they must convert to the preaching of the gospel; leaving first love includes not caring about church or sinners.

faqs.question: What does 1 Samuel 8:7 say about rejecting God’s rule?
faqs.answer: They have not rejected Samuel but God, that he should not rule over them—applied to humanists who reject God-love ruling their life.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And the LORD said to Samuel, “Heed the voice of the people in all that they say to you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me, that I should not reign over them.

faqs.question: How do you recognize false prophets in this sermon?
faqs.answer: By their fruits (Matthew 7:15)—speech either from God toward love and good works or from the Devil toward destruction.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves. You will know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes from thornbushes or figs from thistles? Even so, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit. A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit. Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire. Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

faqs.question: What does Galatians 6:7 say about sowing and reaping?
faqs.answer: God is not mocked; what a man sows he reaps—sow to the flesh and reap corruption.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

faqs.question: What two steps does he give for real hope and change?
faqs.answer: Admit you’re wrong for promoting failed outcomes, then repent—change your thinking; confessing wrongs works for everyone, not only Bible believers.

faqs.question: What does Ephesians 5:11 say about works of darkness?
faqs.answer: Have no fellowship with unfruitful works of darkness but reprove them; it is a shame to speak of things done in secret—they should not be publicly promoted.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather expose them.

faqs.question: Who does he say can unite to make America righteous again?
faqs.answer: Humanists, atheists, and Christians—repent, admit wrong, change, and unite around love that does not hurt anyone and corrects criminals.
